verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe GitHub's pull request workflow for creating and reviewing code. You can review a diff and then open a pull request, and you can read, review and collaborate on PRs from web, mobile and CLI. Copilot code review adds feedback with suggested changes you can apply in a couple of clicks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of human line-level inline review comments, detail on diff comparison views (e.g. split/unified, comparing branches), independent hands-on corroboration.
